verdict.rationale: CoreWeave provides self-service cluster creation via Cloud Console, Terraform, or API (coreweave-docs-1, coreweave-docs-5, coreweave-docs-6), with multi-node pools, autoscaling, and quota/capacity finder tools (coreweave-docs-15, coreweave-docs-16, coreweave-docs-23) that allow provisioning without a sales interaction. Bare-metal Kubernetes without hypervisor overhead (coreweave-docs-14) supports performance-sensitive distributed training. missing for 10: explicit documentation of fast interconnect (e.g., InfiniBand/NVLink) specs, and independent/hands-on confirmation that self-service provisioning works end-to-end without needing to contact sales for capacity allocation.
